items.title: Uber Technologies (UBER) Expands Its Marketplace Into Retail And Resale Delivery
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) has added retail delivery partnerships with Kohl's Corporation and AutoParts.com to its U.S. app-based marketplace. The company has agreed a new collaboration with Kijiji in Canada to handle delivery of secondhand goods listed on the classifieds platform. These arrangements extend Uber's delivery offering beyond food and groceries into categories such as apparel, home goods, auto parts, and resale items. items.title: Musk Says Teslas Will Tap “Grok’s Real-Time X Feed.” Another Tie Between Tesla and SpaceX
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk says Tesla’s cars will combine shared traffic data with Grok’s real-time X feed, a product SpaceX owns. Uber and Lyft would have a hard time matching it, since their robotaxis come from partners like Avride and Waymo.

items.title: Musk Says Cybercab “Would Win Even at Price Parity.” That’s a Problem for Uber and Lyft
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said Tesla’s Cybercab would win riders even at the same price as rivals, replying to a post about Dallas riders turning down discounts. If that holds, Uber and Lyft can’t win those riders back by matching fares, and their robotaxi partners Lucid and Mobileye face a car riders already prefer.
